categories.name: Consensus correctness and cross-node determinism
categories.why: GnB: PoW, compact targets and ASERT are exact and deterministic (exhaustive and differential evidence), but blocks are validated against the local tip (DAG-1), coinbase uniqueness and same-block maturity are missing (VAL-2, VAL-3) and the reorg cap is node-local (DAG-6), so honest nodes can split permanently. Core: connect-time validation in parent context, BIP30/34, no local reorg cap; mainnet timewarp mitigation (BIP-94) is still limited to testnet4/regtest.

categories.name: Network and RPC DoS resistance
categories.why: GnB: one frame panics the processor (POW-2); gossip is relayed before validation and the ~0.8 s PoW runs on self-declared bits (NET-2); orphan pool and deep forks are nearly free (POW-3, POW-4); honest peers are penalised (NET-4, NET-5). Decoders are well bounded and RPC binds to loopback. Core: validation before relay, cheap PoW first, headers presync, misbehaviour scoring, addrman, per-peer download limits.

categories.name: Block and transaction validation, monetary integrity
categories.why: GnB: checked arithmetic everywhere, CVE-2010-5139, CVE-2012-2459 and CVE-2018-17144 classes covered, coinbase value and carryover verified; same-block coinbase spend, no witness commitment, no MoneyRange, size rules split across encodings. Core: CheckTransaction/CheckTxInputs/ConnectBlock with MoneyRange, mutation detection and witness commitment.

categories.name: Mempool and block-production liveness
categories.why: GnB: one dust transaction or ~116 ordinary ones make every template invalid (MEM-1, MEM-2); conflicts never leave the pool (MEM-3); template parents can exceed MAX_PARENTS (DAG-2). Core: standardness before script checks, removeConflicts/removeForReorg/Expire, weight-bounded templates checked with TestBlockValidity.

categories.name: Cryptographic implementation
categories.why: GnB: hybrid ML-DSA-65 AND Falcon-1024 with exact-length parsing, constant-time clean Falcon, fail-closed RNG, chain-id sighash, official ACVP and round-3 vectors; but consensus accepts witness malleation, suites are separable, sighash has no amount commitment and secrets are not zeroized. Core: libsecp256k1 with exhaustive and constant-time tests, strict encodings, BIP143/341 sighash, secure allocator. Post-quantum readiness is noted but not scored (it depends on assumptions about future adversaries, not on code).

categories.name: Test depth and consistency testing
categories.why: GnB: ~900 tests incl. proptests, KAT/ACVP vectors and Python differentials, all passing; but the state layer and the binary-only message processor are untested, a test file is compiled out, the real ASERT path is disabled by feature unification, and 37 mutants survive in gnb-smh. Core: 900 unit cases, 285 functional scripts, data-driven vectors (tx_valid/invalid, sighash, script_tests).

categories.name: Defensive coding, memory and arithmetic safety
categories.why: GnB: memory-safe Rust, #![forbid(unsafe_code)] in consensus crates, 3 unsafe sites in production (FFI), overflow-checks in release; but reachable overflow panics, swallowed write errors and no acceptance lock. Core: C++ mitigated by sanitizers, 1,696 thread-safety annotations, Assert/Assume/CHECK_NONFATAL discipline.

categories.name: Fuzzing, CI, release engineering and supply chain
categories.why: GnB: CI never compiles the workspace; no fuzz harness (corpora only); deny.toml fails its own policy; reachable advisories ignored; vendored guards cannot run. Core: 26 CI configurations (ASan/UBSan/integer, MSan, TSan, valgrind, fuzz, tidy, cross-arch), 206 fuzz targets, lint suite.

categories.name: Wallet and key management
categories.why: GnB: Argon2id 256 MiB and AES-256-GCM with authenticated parameters, 0600 atomic files, strict wallet CSP; but signers trust API-supplied values without a fee cap, the web origin link is plaintext, explorer pages lack CSP and escaping. Core: values from own chain state, amount-committing sighash, -maxtxfee, waste-based coin selection, secure allocator (weaker, GPU-friendly KDF).

total_note: Weighted mean of the category scores. Each category score is the lead auditor's calibration of the reviewers' 0-10 component scores against the findings and positive controls in this report.
